ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, November 14, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Ag Production & Processing, Construction Management, Digital & Precision Ag, Energy and the Environment, French Commercial, Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design students on Monday, November 21, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. BUSINESS MINOR/PROSPECTIVE BUSINESS MINOR STUDENTS: This section will not open to you since all students are required to take the online option, if offered, as stated on the Business Minor website. No exceptions will be made. BADM 310 is offered online every term with an enrollment limit. There are currently 20 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 20, 2023 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course. This is a core course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Food Science & Human Nutrition or Business Undeclared or Accountancy or Finance or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Information Systems or Operations Management or STR BUS DEV & Entrepreneurship or Finance + Data Science or Accountancy + Data Science or Strategy, Innovation & Entrep major(s) or minor(s).
